The contract date passed 50 days ago, and no P6 update was submitted this week. The contract was due to finish on 05-Oct-2026. At 24-Nov-2026 the work is 99.96% complete; the guard houses and testing and commissioning now read 100%, and only the fences (99.1%) remain. The only schedule file uploaded this week is the original baseline, so the latest forecast is still that of the 16-Nov-2026 P6 update: project finish on 26-Nov-2026, 52 days after the contract date, with −45 days of float. The weekly report still forecasts 05-Oct-2026 with no variance.

The 14 field inspection requests added this week cover 26 m of gate-link fence at the three guard houses (posts, mesh and barbed wire), 18,171 m of fibre-optic cable, 114 m of road-crossing ducts, 9 fibre-optic manholes, 10 sets of 6 m electric gate barriers, 16.67 m² of stair tiles and 15.39 m² of footing bitumen coating.
